dogecoin.text:
Robinhood users are having problems trading crypto again today as dogecoin rises past 60 cents apiece. 

Robinhood previously experienced issues with its crypto platform last month when traders tried to push dogecoin to $1.

This was supposed to be Robinhood's big year. But disappointing earnings results this week--including a 78% quarter-over-quarter plunge in cryptocurrency revenue--shows what can happen when individual investors move on to other hot trades. My latest:
